[2:59PM] #OkeOdo #trafficUpdate 

The stretch from Ajegunle inward Alakuko, Kola, Meiran, and Ijaiye through to Abule Egba is experiencing free flow. Ascending Jubilee Bridge inward Super is also clear, though approaching Ile Epo is slightly slow due to market and bus stop activities. However, the onward journey towards Pleasure remains very good.

On the return journey, movement from Pleasure inward Ile Epo down to Super is flowing well. Similarly, ascending Jubilee Bridge from Super inward Abule Egba, through Awori, down to Ijaiye, Meiran, Kola, Alakuko, and Ajegunle is free of impediments.

At Oja Oba, beneath Jubilee Bridge where traffic lights regulate movement, the situation is calm and steady, extending down to Charity Junction. The connection from Charity Road down to Social Club inward Olayiwola is also clear, while movement towards and from Abattoir, including the return journey to Charity Junction, remains smooth.
Personnel are strategically positioned to monitor and maintain the traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
RUN FREE, TIKTOK 🙏

 Bach Project PH mourned the death of rescued dog “Tiktok” from a car accident on Sunday, Sept. 7.

“We don’t know how to put this into words. Today, we lost Tiktok in a tragic accident while she was in foster care,” the local animal welfare group said in a social media post.

The group reported that Tiktok slipped out, ran, and was hit by a car. “It was so sudden, and even now, it feels impossible to accept,” they added.
